insulator2.master_status: Exact public v1 source ac925520 and its protected GLB14d3eea5 are supplied in preflight40; not a private gray source. v2 adds UV plus original color/roughness maps only.

procedural_recipe.source: Original irregular elongated streaks plus fine grain. Two relatedJV581404 physical photographs support visible nonuniform striated finish only; no chemistry, length, angle or depth measured. No photograph pixels.
procedural_recipe.scope: Only original color and roughness variations realized; no geometric/normal displacement or measured relief claim. Six source-native zero tangents recorded; source indices/normals protected.

insulator2.bake: Two EMIT atlas maps2048², CPU16 samples,12px margin; elongated4Dnoise W581.404 and fineW582.404 mixed.7/.3, angle20deg. Basecolor sRGB, roughness Non-Color; no normalmap, bump, displacement, RNG external seed file or photo pixels.
insulator2.context: Inherited head3 is a relative Library, hidden except conditional-head-context render; not fused/exported into the one authored body. Manifold1 appears as conditional interface-check input in40 but is not read by build_v2.py or its material bake.
insulator2.private_diagnostics: check_material_export_v2.mjs extracts public GLB texture payloads and UV samples under /workspace/wewa-assets/work-in-progress/engine-intake-insulator/exported-v2-textures; check_exported_map_pixels_v2.py reads those generated derivatives. No master promotion needed. Preview output/checkpoints also private, not bake inputs.

regeneratable_intermediates_not_external.path_limit: Hardcoded output location; parent directory must be available in a future isolated rebuild or explicitly relocated in a new working recipe. No production script reads this .blend.

swingarm1.photos: Two related52PF0219 specimen views are documentary only; build/material/refinement scripts do not read their pixels or meshes.
swingarm1.geometry_vs_context: All constructed body geometry is native. No imported pivot/wheel/crankcase guide is required by body recipe or material restart.

findings.statement: No indispensable private authored master or photo texture input found. Both material recipes have their stable source inputs locally present.

Swingarm material replay additionally needs stable gray-review.json and source-geometry-check metadata. Master and own source scripts are in26; gray-review currently outside26 is explicitly planned in record.py final manifest. This audit provides its SHA without editing26 or claiming final seal.

Swingarm refine_needles writes a diagnostic .blend under absolute /workspace/wewa-assets. It is a disposable output, not a read/master. Insulator pixel dumps similarly derive from supplied GLB. Preserve role distinction; no private original promotion warranted.

Blender4.3.2 uses bundled numpy; body CSG calls shutil.which(python), importing manifold3d and numpy in host Python. Body requirements.txt pins manifold3d3.3.2/Pillow12.3.0 but not numpy; shared tools/requirements-assets.txt pins numpy2.3.5. Render helper tools/blender_component_camera_preflight.py is a public import outside body26. No binary exact-rebuild or moved-clone run performed.

Restoring G3 or executing builders would overwrite active paths. Work only in a separate copy/revision; frozen source files, manifests and previous README were not changed. Insulator build_v2 explicitly refuses an existing preflight-v2; body scripts rely on workflow isolation rather than such a recipe guard.

swingarm_final_review_state: Final four views owned by manufacturer, still in progress according to assignment. Their active render-report is not read/hashed as a stable recipe file by this audit; no final manifest is closed.
limitations: No full reconstruction or native Blender opening performed. Static scripts and supplied SHA-bound artifacts support dependency closure, not bitwise regeneration.
